topic: The fridge at midnight, watching the owner open the door for the tenth time.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Midnight Fridge

shots.narration: Ten visits tonight. I'm a fridge, not a season finale.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy modern kitchen at night, bright 3D cartoon style, unmarked refrigerator beneath soft blue moonlight, no visible text.
shots.action: The refrigerator, with big weary eyes and a small mouth on its side panel, swings open under a pajama-sleeved hand.
shots.mood: Warm interior light against a sleepy blue kitchen, exaggerated disbelief.

shots.narration: I showed you this exact cheese five minutes ago.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open refrigerator with cheese, a covered bowl and plain food containers, cute face visible on the outer side panel, no labels or text.
shots.action: The refrigerator, with big expressive eyes and a small flat mouth, directs its gaze toward the cheese.
shots.mood: Bright fridge light, patient but visibly unimpressed.

shots.narration: [sighs] Apparently, staring harder is supposed to summon cake.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, midnight kitchen, open refrigerator with a conspicuously empty middle shelf, no visible text.
shots.action: The refrigerator, with big expressive eyes and a small downturned mouth, squints at an owner leaning close to its empty shelf.
shots.mood: Awkward stillness, cool light, comic disappointment.

shots.narration: You close me like I've personally disappointed you.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy moonlit kitchen, refrigerator side panel clearly visible beside the door, no visible text.
shots.action: A pajama-sleeved hand shuts the refrigerator, whose big eyes and small mouth form an offended expression.
shots.mood: Abrupt darkness around the door seam, wounded dignity.

shots.narration: Then you return, hoping I've had a plot twist.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same midnight kitchen and unchanged refrigerator contents, no visible text.
shots.action: The owner reopens the refrigerator, whose big eyes and small mouth hold an exhausted expression.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] Wonderful. Now we're inspecting the cheese from below.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open refrigerator in a cosy kitchen, owner crouched beside the lower shelves, no visible text.
shots.action: The refrigerator, with big downward-looking eyes and a small pursed mouth, watches the crouching owner peer upward at the cheese.
shots.mood: Overly serious inspection of an ordinary snack.

shots.narration: Finally, you choose the leftovers you've ignored all evening.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open refrigerator with a plain covered bowl on the middle shelf, no visible text.
shots.action: A hand removes the covered bowl from the refrigerator, whose big eyes and small smiling mouth show relief.
shots.mood: Warm, triumphant relief over a tiny achievement.

shots.narration: I can finally close my eyes.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, quiet blue kitchen, closed refrigerator beside a countertop microwave with an unlit blank display, no visible text.
shots.action: The refrigerator, with big sleepy eyes and a small contented mouth, lowers its eyelids.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Microwave, you're up. They've chosen something with sauce.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, refrigerator beside an open countertop microwave, covered bowl of saucy leftovers in an owner's hand, no visible text.
shots.action: The owner places the bowl inside the microwave beside the refrigerator, whose big eyes and small crooked smile look delighted.
shots.mood: Mischievous relief, warm spotlight on the microwave's next problem.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the microwave faces another midnight emergency.
episode.description: It's midnight, and the fridge is tired of being checked for snacks that weren't there five minutes ago. One more inspection might finally break its cool.
